description: Random noise generator whose values are held for an adjustable time, giving white noise at one end and stepped noise at the other

params.text: Sets how long each random value is held, 0 to 1ms, a new value being drawn every sample at zero

inputs.text: 0-10V adds to the duration knob, 10V adding the full 1ms

menu: uniform — draws each random value evenly across the range
gaussian — draws each random value clustered around the middle of the range, with a slider under it setting the deviation, 0.1 to 0.9
